text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Thanks so much for giving me time off! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yup! I rewatched the whole Sumo Broadcasting: Best Matches Compilation! It was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I've got an idea! We should go watch some live sumo wrestling together, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like Hishi Akebono had a nice, refreshing break.
